result.summary: The pedestrian environment features high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized traffic control, providing a basic level of safety. However, the wide roadway lacks a pedestrian refuge island and visible pedestrian signals, increasing exposure and potential confusion for those crossing.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide multi-lane roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure in a mixed-use urban setting. However, it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and traffic calming measures like curb extensions, which increases exposure for people crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions results in a longer crossing distance and potentially higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide two-lane urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median or pedestrian signals increase risk.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show remaining crossing time to improve pedestrian decision-making.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals, though markings are significantly faded. The wide, open geometry and lack of modern safety enhancements like curb extensions or high-visibility crosswalks suggest a moderate risk environment.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection on the left and right sides.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway and near the crossing area can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide better information to people crossing.
